blocs.name: Traditionalists
blocs.speaker: Elder Bai
blocs.agenda: Keep the old rites, the vaults closed and the ladder slow.

blocs.name: Reformists
blocs.speaker: Instructor Rui
blocs.agenda: Open the outer hall to talent from anywhere, not only the old families.

blocs.name: Militants
blocs.speaker: The gate captain
blocs.agenda: Spend the sect's strength abroad before it rusts in the courtyards.
